text: With the partitioned glass keeping me at the periphery of the lively, focused room, I feel like an observer of human concentration — both included and isolated by the architecture. Stepping into the next room, where walls burst with color and bold words promise innovation, I sense anticipation. It feels like I am moving from the structured rigor of communal thought to the playful unpredictability of invention. There is energy and curiosity in this transition, as if I too am being invited to experiment and rethink my own boundaries.
